setting: Weekly predicted numbers bought every day for 5 days; daily budget 5 units (¥1000) unless pool.
theorem: Under theoretical equal return ratio (~45%), any mix with same weekly spend has the same E[net]. Worst-case loss is always -weekly_spend on a total miss week.

fixed_1000_per_day.recommendation: If goal is avoid empty weeks: all mini (M5B0S0). If goal is rare but large recovery: more straight. If goal is middle: M3B1S1 or M3B2S0. There is no mix that both raises expected profit AND lowers expected loss vs another same-budget mix.
